segments.expected: Every window was lit, as it always was. The lamps on the brass brackets in the hall were lit, white, and the lamps in the glass globes on the newel posts, and the great iron ring slung from the stairwell's ceiling. Kiva went up the stair with her left hand in her coat and her right on nothing, and on the fourth step she waited for her heart to slow, and it did not.
